description: Estimate a one-rep max (1RM) from a set of weight × reps, with a percentage table and the load each rep count should allow. Epley by default, Brzycki optional. Estimates above 10 reps are flagged as less reliable.

formula.description: One-rep max formula: epley (weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30), the one the IronLedger app uses) or brzycki (weight × 36 ÷ (37 − reps)).

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

name: one_rep_max
title: One-rep max calculator
